summary:
Dan Hamilton is a fictional orthopaedic surgeon in the BBC medical drama *Holby City*, played by Adam Astill. He first appeared on 15 February 2011 as a new consultant at Holby General.

Dan is portrayed as impulsive and overconfident, with weak patient-management skills. His main storylines include a romance with ward sister Chrissie Williams and a rivalry with registrar Antoine Malick. After learning Malick is gay, Dan kisses him, then struggles to understand his own feelings. The storyline drew mixed reviews: some critics praised the actors and writing, while others considered the plot familiar. Some viewers also complained to the BBC about the same-sex storyline, which the broadcaster defended as part of reflecting real life.

Astill announced in May 2012 that he would leave the series. His exit storyline showed Dan becoming more comfortable with himself as he chose which path to follow.
